messages:
Maya (Design): @here quick mock — proposing a compact token stack in the spend row so users can see tokens + fiat in one hit. sticky scope switcher on the left so org/project toggle stays visible while scrolling. Screenshot attached (not in json).
Eric (PM): love the sticky scope idea. question: does compact stack hide monthly invoice CTA? we need that to be discoverable for finance teams.
Sam (FE): technically fine, but sticky left rail increases horizontal real estate on small screens. we should collapse to an icon+label at <= 980px.
Lina (Eng): perf note — making the rail sticky for thousands of rows could reflow. we should virtualize rows and keep only one sticky element.
Ryan (Design Lead): Agree with Maya on compactness but want clear visual separation between token breakdown and sparkline. maybe a subtle divider and increased contrast on token numbers.
Olivia (Content): Invoice CTA copy suggestion: "Download invoice (CSV & PDF)" -> clearer for teams. Also consider aria-label: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period" for screen readers.
Maya (Design): good call on aria-label. Proposed microcopy: "Invoice — Download PDF/CSV" (small label under total).
Sam (FE): for keyboard users, ensure the scope toggle is focusable and has an aria-pressed state when toggled.
Lina (Eng): CSS snippet for focus outline I can use:
```
.scope-toggle:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); border-radius: 6px; }
```
Eric (PM): accessibility + discoverability both matter. primary asks: (1) make invoice action always reachable within two tab stops from scope toggle; (2) mobile fallback shows invoice action in header.
Ryan (Design Lead): visual density options — we could offer a compact/dense switch in the top-right of the spend view so power users can toggle. thoughts?
Maya (Design): compact toggle ok, but avoid adding too many controls to toolbar. maybe persistence in user settings instead of toolbar.
Olivia (Content): +1 user settings persistence. Also suggest a tooltip for the token tooltip: "Includes prefix cache hits & reused tokens" — short and technical audience-friendly.
Sam (FE): implementation details: token numbers are currently server-calculated. if we introduce compact stacking we may need an extra prop for "showFiatInline" to avoid recompute on client.
Lina (Eng): backend ok with a flag, but watch out for increased response payload. we can default to server-side and lazy-load fiat conversions on hover for large result sets.
Eric (PM): decision runway: prioritize accessibility + invoice discoverability this sprint. leave compact density as opt-in in settings for next sprint.
Maya (Design): action items: (1) update mock with divider + stronger token contrast; (2) move invoice CTA to persistent spot near scope toggle; (3) provide alt mock for <=980px collapsed rail.
Sam (FE): I’ll scope the CSS/JS changes and surface any perf tradeoffs.
Lina (Eng): I’ll add virtualization + one sticky element. I’ll review potential payload changes with backend.
Olivia (Content): I’ll finalize CTA copy and aria-labels.
Ryan (Design Lead): I’ll coordinate final visual tweaks and sign-off once updated mock is in Figma.
Maya (Design): thanks! tagging follow-ups: @Eric (PM) — can you confirm acceptance criteria for invoice discoverability? then I’ll push the mock. :thumbsup:
Eric (PM): Confirmed. Acceptance: invoice download within two tab stops of scope toggle, visible on mobile header, and screen-reader label present.
ui-bot: Reminder: Design review meeting scheduled tomorrow 11:00 — add updated mock to the agenda.
Maya (Design): added. moving to update now.
